[h2]Hello, dear Aquarists!😌🐠[/h2]

[h3]The new Aquarist update is HERE🔥[/h3]

🔹 The long-awaited feature of placing plants in other decorations has been added. Yes, now you can set, for example, a stone as static and attach a plant to it. All plants now have the option of being attached to other objects that are set as static/placed in the substrate/placed in the aquarium background. Even more possibilities for your creativity!

🔹 The ability to stop time has been added! Many players have requested this feature. Now, when there is a lot going on, you can stop time at any moment and calmly take care of whatever you want (remember that the fish will not need food, they will not die, but they will also not reproduce or grow)

🔹 When shopping, you can add items to your favourites, which will make them easier to find later. There is also a new tab in the shop that displays all your favourite items

🔹 You can put universal pH on the tool shelf

🔹 Minor UI fixes

[/h2]

🔹A new panel has been added to the management tablet, featuring a bank section where you can take out a loan that you will repay in instalments. This may make it easier to get started, but you always have to be careful with banks!

🔹 It used to happen that the restocker would put empty boxes in the restock room, taking up space. After loading the game, this will fix itself and empty boxes will always end up in the bin.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
We are back with another batch of bug fixes to make the game even better and for you to continue playing without any problems!

Amendments:

- Fixed a bug that caused fish that were in good conditions in tanks in the oceanarium and museum to become much smaller than they should be. We were surprised that we discovered this bug only now and no one had reported it before. From now on, specimens in these locations can be much larger!!! Definitely come in and see how big fish you can now have in your tanks in these levels!!!

- The number of plants and decorations in large tanks has been adapted to their size. Thanks to this, now you can put much more things in the largest tank in the oceanarium and in the tanks in the museum and the requirements of the fish will still be met! You can finally decorate your tanks even more.

- Fixed the bug that the sea explorer quest disappeared from the basement location when the player moved to the exhibition level, now everything works correctly (For those who encountered this bug, after 6 days in the game the basement quest should appear again so the bug will fix itself)

- Fixed bug in underwater expedition levels. If a player has lost a utility item or the item has sunk into the ground, after reloading this level, these items should be on the table in our base again.

- Improved mechanics of using the hammer, now you can destroy/build much easier. We fixed the situation where sometimes the game did not count hits with the hammer and it just works and feels better :)

- For tasks with rare species from marine researchers, an option has been added when the player fails to complete the task (the fish died or you sold all of them before finishing the quest). You can close such a task and the note about the rare fish will disappear.

- Fixed a bug where purchased fish that did not fit in the inventory and ended up on the table very often could not be picked up

- Fixed a rare bug that blocked the cleaning machine in the museum level, making it unusable and blocking access to change to other locations. Now this no longer happens, and for those who have encountered such an error, the game will fix it itself

- Fixed a bug that happens very rarely, when loading the game, aquarium decorations appeared in the wrong places and in strange sizes and the fish started dying. From now on, this won't happen to anyone

- Fixed a bug that when throwing fish into some tanks, the caustics of the water in the aquarium turned off for a moment, now it’s correct.

- In the underwater expedition (Greek), fish trapped in nets appear on the radar as red dots, just like in the Egyptian expedition.

- Fixed a bug where it was very difficult to pick up the aquarium or enter the edit mode at one table in the basement (it was the one right next to the door), now everything works correctly

- Hammer hit particles when hit with a hammer only appear when the item can actually be destroyed

- Fixed a bug that sometimes blocked the money that the player received in the UI and remained suspended in the air when it should have disappeared

- Improved game loading on underwater levels where rewards received for cleaning the seabed were not always saved

- Fixed that goldfish became invisible when player were inside an aquarium

- Fixed a bug that made it impossible to enter the letter Q in the names of aquariums because the inspection panel closed then, now it is possible

- Fixed a bug where players playing on monitors with a width of 1280 pixels or less could not completely clean the walls of the aquariums from algae

- Fixed a bug where the player pressed the pause button while holding a sponge and standing in front of a dirty aquarium, which when resuming the game moved him to clean the wall, bugging the game by creating a strange camera shake effect

- Fixed the box in the cave in the aquarium that was stuck in the wall and couldn't be pulled out

- We have updated the game icon on the desktop to a newer and nicer one

- Many minor game and UI fixes

[list]
[*][b]a completely new task[/b] has been added to the game for a client who asks us to help him prepare [b]aquariums and more on his desert island.[/b] 😱🌅 Will you be able to prepare everything [b]without access to the store[/b] and based on things you can find on the island? [b]Of course, there are new fish and decorations to discover![/b] 🐬🌊
[*][b]algae-eating fish[/b] have been added to the game. A new icon with the algae-eater attribute appears next to the appropriate fish. Such fish [b]slowly eat algae from aquariums, so you won't have to do it manually and your aquarium will be well-kept.[/b] 😜🍃
[*][b]a new aquarium has been added to the game[/b] which the player can buy and use. A tall aquarium allows you to introduce [b]even more fish[/b] and arrange the decorations better! 🐠🐡
[*]if a certain number of aquarium cleaning tasks are completed, customers will receive a [b]reward in the form of 3 new fish[/b] that will make your freshwater aquariums even more diverse!🤩
[*]two fish models have been [b]replaced with much nicer versions:[/b] Amphiprion ocellaris and Zanclus cornutus 👀
[*][b]one additional fish[/b] available from the very beginning of the game has been added a new variation of the [i]Balistoides conspicillum[/i] fish 
[*][b]a diving mask effect has been added[/b] when going underwater in underwater levels🌊 [*]selling/removing decorations no longer causes an "explosion" 😱💥 near the decoration, this means that other items placed near the removed decoration will not be moved/overturned, [b]which makes building aquariums easier[/b]
[*]the crowbar [b]can now be placed in the tool cabinet[/b]
[*][b]added achievement[/b] for placing all pearls on the exhibition 🔮✨
[*][b]added achievement[/b] for completing a client task on a deserted island 🌞🌴

[*]being inside the aquarium [b]we can see the upper water surface,[/b] which improves the visual effect of being underwater 🥽

notes.title: Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Summer [/b]is here!
[b]And with it - many new improvements for Aquarist![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/8a9a6ff1b78b91a097f5cabe717dda4734d10956.png[/img]
[u][b]A list of changes:[/b][/u][list]
[*] a [b]new inspection system[/b] has been added to the game, allowing you to easily manage fish in the aquarium: sell them, check what they are missing, etc. You will not have to click on each fish separately, but a list of all fish in a given aquarium [b]will be easily accessible[/b]
[*] added[b] 8 new achievements[/b] related to museum level and underwater level
[*] a [b]Steam Cloud service has been added[/b] to the game that saves players' saves[b] in the cloud[/b]
[*] the [b]sprint option has been added in the game[/b], the player holding shift can move a little faster
[*] fixed a bug that sometimes players entering the pouring of substrate into the aquarium and [b]could not take soil from the bag and could not do anything[/b]
[*] in the museum you can now[b] feed sharks by putting meat in the aquarium[/b]
[*] in the aquarium in the expedition room there is[b] a new trophy [/b]for completing all the skeletons in the museum
[*] fixed the bug that in the museum large rocks[b] were getting smaller [/b]after loading the game, now [b]you can fully decorate the museum locations with HUGE decorations![/b] ːsteamhappyː
[*] in the museum, after the end of the day, money from the income from visitors[b] is correctly awarded[/b]
[*] added option in the frame limiter settings that[b] allows you to specify the maximum number of displayed fps[/b]
[*] [b]improved visibility[/b] in the Greek underwater level, now the map is actually covered with water and we can't see very distant objects which improves the [b]impression [/b]of underwater depth, also [b]improved bottom refraction in underwater levels[/b]
[*] fixed a bug that in the basement sometimes the player lost access to the table by the window and could not place an aquarium on it, [b]now it is always possible and those who have such a bug will be fixed after the update and will be able to use this place on the aquarium again[/b]
[*] fixed bug that fish reproduced in large numbers after[b] exceeding their limit of maximum fish [/b]in the aquarium for a given species

[h3]Welcome, our underwater Friends! 🐠

[u][b]A list of changes:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]a new amazing part has been added to the aquarium![/b] A beautiful [b]cave with built-in aquariums[/b], customizable lighting, and [b]exotic species[/b] to be prepared for visitors. We can expect: [b]shrimps, jellyfish, glo fish[/b] (glows in the dark), [b]electric catfish[/b] (can kill with electricity) [b]and Arapaima[/b] (giant freshwater fish)

[*] [b]the water pH system[/b] hit the game. Now the player will have to carefully choose what to do regarding it, extreme neglect of this factor [b]can even kill the fish[/b]!

[*] the game already supports most ultrawide resolutions: 5120x1440, 3840x1600, 3440x1440, 2560x1080 and 4k resolution 3840x2160

[*][b] an automatic feeder has been added to the game![/b] will help you to feed the fish when your aquariums become really large, but remember that[b] it also has a limited capacity,[/b] after which you need to refill it

[*] [b]fixed a bug[/b] that it was possible to do the task at the client's level over and over again at the exhibition

[*] an additional[b] internal saves backup system has been added to the game.[/b] If your subscription broke (the game started from the beginning or deleted your aquariums), contact us immediately via e-mail: piotr.pochopien.krk@gmail.com and we will save your records and you will be able to return to the game

[*] you can no longer get stuck accidentally selling an aquarium, or opening a shop to visitors with an item in your hand

[*] [b]after hovering over the icon[/b], we will get[b] hints[/b] what exactly it means, [b]when buying fish, after hovering over the icon[/b], [b]we will see exactly how many plants and decorations it needs to feel good in the aquarium[/b]

[*] [b]fixed a bug[/b] that sometimes items were left in our hands and it was impossible to get rid of them

[*] the hammer[b] can be put back in the item cupboard
[/b]
[*] [b]removed strange shadows[/b] that appeared on the basement floor

[*] farmed fish that have reached their maximum sales volume[b] provide a little more money
[/b]
[*][b] repaired disappearing decorative plants[/b] in pots when approaching them

[*] [b]fixed a bug[/b] that the fish left in the bags changed their size after loading the game

[*] fishes that cannot fit into the aquarium in a given level [b]will not appear in the shop for purchase,[/b] so as not to make an accidental purchase

[*] swimming under the large aquarium in the oceanarium [b]is easier
[/b]
[*] [b]improved system of plants in the game[/b], after loading the game, the plant resumes its growing process correctly, if it was dying, it continues dying and there is no situation that we will grow giant plants

[*] [b]improved scrolling of the shop[/b] when browsing items (fingers tired from scrolling will rest;))

[*][b] in-game UI fixes in different languages[/b]. The subtitles will no longer obscure important information, and the information itself will be displayed in a formatted way 

[*] [b]many minor and major bugs[/b] reported by players[b] have been fixed[/b] [b](thank you for all your reports!)[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Let us know what you think about the newest update, enjoy our trailer and... Go with the glow! 😁[/h3]

notes.title: 01/21 DEVLOG - Aquarium Guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/79c46a3cb79e4753fcdfa1c96a63fd312bf536e6.png[/img]

Welcome to the first Aquarius Devlog! Today we will show you how to set up you own aquarium! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/00a9da4ca5b4145a72b225bcbd9d16d747ce4f3d.png[/img]

First things first, we have to set up Aquarium on the stand. Gravel and Water are already in there, so you don't have to worry. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/edba041e4ffb3f55d10b96e86b09e8934ca5340e.png[/img]

Let's go crazy! In the shop you will find all necessary equipment - from plants to lamps. Choose what you need and...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/5cdc546505476d1132d1b29ffb48fd3300c59848.png[/img]

DECORATE! This is only limited by your imagination. We will add some of the rocks, so that the fish can feel safe and hide behind them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/04b03352be408bca03fdaff630205224fa0cc19c.png[/img]

Few plants will definitely make aquarium alive. Let's add them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/d86ecd7581973174f69645df534c3ce6f0b746d1.png[/img]

Feeling into disco mood? The lists will perfectly complete the look. Green and purple will look wild! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/ead18c326dd7bdf1768baca98a0879f32f535ae3.png[/img]

If you're dealing with freshwater fish, you'll need a filtering system. You will find it in the shop. We just have to find a good place and ready. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/90abff75fbba03f903b7304c4b7a0dfe53cfedc1.png[/img]

The fish are ready to see new home. Let's see how they will turn up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/5d77d0b9aee288236011d94cdc9764ecdc1d47fe.png[/img]

Complete! Fish feel well and it looks amazing, isn't it?
